criteria.requirement: 1. After all required creation steps and dedicated mode adjustments, submit the complete versioned creation/play handshake exactly once and wait for authoritative play acknowledgement.

source.quote: | `capability.birth.complete` | Only after all required creation steps and dedicated mode adjustments submit final identity, stats, options, geometry and graphics/resource handshake and wait for play acknowledgement. | `source.baseline.session-play`, `source.baseline.session-dna`, `source.baseline.session-setup`, `source.policy.session` |

criteria.requirement: 2. Use production defaults and identity bytes required by the baseline outcome.

source.quote: Handshake использует production defaults/identity bytes, требуемые полным

criteria.requirement: 3. Verify exact bytes and version gates for final identity, stats, options, geometry, graphics, font/resource fields and dedicated adjustments through the production SV serializer. Controller review and fresh final audit must establish production-path evidence; baseline runner success alone does not establish this evidence.

source.quote: font/resource fields и dedicated adjustments через production serializer.

criteria.requirement: 4. Send no final request before all legal creation steps complete; double confirm, resize, focus and interleaved packets must not duplicate the final request.

source.quote: 2. До завершения всех legal steps send отсутствует; double confirm, resize,

criteria.requirement: 5. Acknowledgement, rejection, disconnect, partial replies and malformed replies return control to the correct owner; stale generations never open the next surface.

source.quote: правильный owner; stale generation никогда не открывает следующий surface.

criteria.requirement: 6. Fulfil the Guide placeholder obligation through the actual production caller, without substituting Guide implementation or a test-only callback. Controller review and fresh final audit verify this production seam.

source.quote: 4. Guide placeholder obligation выполняется через actual caller, не через Guide

criteria.requirement: 7. After authoritative acknowledgement, peer-driven MOTD leads to live-session handoff without opening a gameplay surface.

source.quote: MOTD ведёт в live-session handoff, не в gameplay surface.

criteria.requirement: 8. Provide controlled-peer runtime evidence showing the exact handshake bytes and authoritative acknowledgement. Implementation readiness or baseline check success alone does not satisfy this full-acceptance evidence requirement; the controller verifies it during review and fresh final audit.

source.quote: Controlled peer видит точные bytes и authoritative acknowledgement. Успех

criteria.requirement: 9. Preserve the dependency on SV-B-023 birth choices and the historical ticket filename for references; DNA load/save remains owned by stage C and is outside this implementation.
criteria.owner: SV-B-024; stage C owns DNA load/save

source.quote: сохранено для ссылок; DNA load/save в этом тикете больше нет и относится к C.

criteria.requirement: 10. Keep profile/resource workflows, real-server integration, session.enter-game and the first gameplay surface outside SV-B-024 acceptance; these remain stage C responsibilities. Handshake resource fields remain required.
criteria.owner: SV-B-024; stage C owns the excluded workflows and integration

source.quote: integration, `session.enter-game` или первый gameplay surface — они остаются C.

criteria.requirement: 11. End successful SV-B-024 acceptance at the startup screen flow boundary; gameplay presentation is not required.

source.quote: заканчивается на границе startup screen flow; gameplay presentation не требуется.

criteria.requirement: 12. Preserve SV-B-025 ownership of the end-to-end entry verification. Its deferred evidence is not passing evidence for this checkpoint.
criteria.deferralReason: The assigned source places end-to-end verification in the downstream SV-B-025 ticket; this checkpoint covers SV-B-024 birth completion.

source.quote: Сквозная проверка — [SV-B-025](SV-B-025-entry-complete.md).

criteria.requirement: 1. Minimize changes to the existing client and shared files when implementing this SV task.

source.quote: Правило пользователя от 2026-09-22: при разработке SV минимизировать изменения

criteria.requirement: 2. Place implementation and adaptation in SV where possible. Permit duplication that preserves isolation and avoids a large dependency set; extract shared code only when needed for this task, rather than solely to eliminate duplication.

source.quote: размещать в SV. Дублирование реализации допустимо, если оно позволяет сохранить

criteria.requirement: 3. Preserve the protocol and gameplay semantics of the behavior baseline during the transfer. Require the immutable SV build and core checks for implementation readiness; assess baseline preservation separately through controller review and fresh final audit.

source.quote: При переносе сохранять протокольную и игровую семантику behavior baseline.

criteria.requirement: 4. Tests must invoke the production SV path. A local SV implementation is permitted; a separate implementation of behavior used only by tests is prohibited. Verify the production seam through controller review and fresh final audit.

source.quote: Тесты должны вызывать production-путь SV; локальная SV-реализация допустима,

criteria.requirement: 5. Record any discovered opportunities to improve legacy code, shared modules, or SV organization in docs/sv-improvements.md, separately from implementing the current feature.

source.quote: записывать в [список улучшений](docs/sv-improvements.md), отдельно от реализации

criteria.requirement: 6. Each improvement entry must identify the problem, affected code, proposal, status, and necessary checks. Recording an improvement does not bring it into this task's implementation scope.

source.quote: предложение, статус и необходимые проверки. Запись сама по себе не включает

criteria.requirement: 7. Do not treat intentional duplication for isolation as a defect or an obligation to consolidate later. Apply the repository isolation rule with priority over older project-document requirements for a shared SV and legacy implementation.

source.quote: Это правило имеет приоритет над прежними формулировками проектных документов,

criteria.requirement: 8. When creating, triaging, or reviewing tasks, use local Markdown: Wayfinder tasks in .scratch/ and SV implementation tickets in docs/tasks/, following the referenced issue-tracker path and status rules without expanding this task's authoritative obligations.
criteria.owner: Agent performing task creation, triage, or review

source.quote: При создании, triage и review задач используйте локальный Markdown: Wayfinder в `.scratch/`, SV implementation tickets в `docs/tasks/`. Правила путей и статусов — в [docs/agents/issue-tracker.md](docs/agents/issue-tracker.md).

criteria.requirement: 9. When performing triage, use the five standard roles and a separate Labels: field, with role correspondence clarified by docs/agents/triage-labels.md.

source.quote: При triage используйте пять стандартных ролей и отдельное поле `Labels:`. Соответствие ролей — в [docs/agents/triage-labels.md](docs/agents/triage-labels.md).

criteria.requirement: 10. Before working with domain terminology or architecture, read the root CONTEXT.md and task-relevant ADRs; use the referenced domain documentation to clarify the single-context layout without introducing obligations outside the fixed authoritative sources.
criteria.owner: Agent performing domain or architecture work

source.quote: Перед работой с доменными терминами или архитектурой читайте корневой `CONTEXT.md` и относящиеся к задаче ADR. Правила single-context layout — в [docs/agents/domain.md](docs/agents/domain.md).
